name: 唯品会
text:
#!name=唯品会
#!author=queitstart pro
#!date=2026-11-21
#!format=sgmodule

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/b\.appsimg\.com\/upload\/momin/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mapi\.appvipshop\.com\/vips-mobile\/rest\/activity\/advertisement\/get/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mapi\.appvipshop\.com\/vips-mobile\/rest\/iosAdInfo\/report/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mapi\.appvipshop\.com\/vips-mobile\/rest\/layout\/productList\/eventData\/v/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mapi\.appvipshop\.com\/vips-mobile\/rest\/activity\/coupon\/float_entrance\/get\?api_key/i then reject(200)

[Rule]
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, n-st.vip.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, api.union.vip.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, ms.vipstatic.com,REJECT

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% b.appsimg.com, mapi.appvipshop.com
